description: Send one request to a business found with find_business_agent, using a skill its card lists: take_message (leave a message), check_availability (read open times), book (book a slot check_availability returned), book_first_available (book the first open slot in up to 5 preferred windows) or cancel_booking (cancel a booking you made). Call find_business_agent first. For a business without a card, use call_business. Say an automated assistant is acting, and get the person's permission before booking. Reuse the same message_id on every retry so a request runs once. Returns the A2A v1.0 {task}: read its state before telling anyone a message was delivered or a booking confirmed. A deposit booking returns INPUT_REQUIRED with a payment_url for the person; it is held 30 minutes and confirmed only after payment. Lookups are free; tasks use the monthly free allowance, then prepaid Direct credit, and failed, refused and unconfirmed tasks cost nothing. Exact prices: get_m2m_network; your balance: get_direct_usage.

approval_id.description: Only when the business approves bookings itself: the action_id (da_...) from its approval_required reply, sent with the same message_id and data once the owner approves.

biz.description: The business id from its card: the <biz> in /b/<biz>/ or /c/<biz>/.

data.description: The skill's fields; put skill beside data, never inside it. take_message: caller_name, callback_number (the person's own E.164 number, never the business's), need, optional on_behalf_of and urgency (low, normal, high or urgent). check_availability: optional service and date (YYYY-MM-DD in the business's time zone). book: slot exactly as check_availability returned it, caller_name, callback_number, need. book_first_available: options (1 to 5 windows in order, each {date, optional after and before as HH:MM, optional service}), fallback (none or take_message), caller_name, callback_number, need. cancel_booking: booking_id and cancel_token from the confirmed booking, optional reason (up to 300 characters); cancelling is free and does not refund a booking fee.

message_id.description: Your id for this request; reuse it unchanged on every retry so the request runs once.

skill.description: One skill the business card lists.

target.description: line (default) for a business line (/b/ card); claim for a claimed listing (/c/ card), which takes messages only.

name: send_to_business
title: Send a business a message or booking
